correctness.independent_verification: Independently reconstructed all Boolean order-polytope vertices, cover facets and their exact vertex masks, closed every facet intersection, and counted incidence rank to distinguish nonsmooth cones for n=4: exactly 37 vertices, 18,447 nonempty faces, 3,071 singular faces, 18 maximal singular strata (codimension 3 six, 4 eight, 5 four) and exactly one smooth torus-fixed point. This independently matches formula N4=8+6+4=18. Source script also reports n3 and n5, but n5 all faces not claimed enumerated; general theorem rests on cycle proof.
correctness.rationale: For n≥4 poset with bottom/top and a_i<b_j for i≠j, the primitive facet normals of its (2n+2)-dimensional order polytope form a totally unimodular signed Hasse incidence matrix. Any active normal cone is regular precisely when its equality graph is a forest. Exhausting *minimal feasible induced cycles*, the boundary configurations K_{2,n−1} yield 2n codim-n components with generic cone over Segre (P1)^{n−1}, multiplicity (n−1)!; middle disjoint-index 4-cycles yield C(n,2)C(n−2,2) codim-three conifolds, multiplicity 2; equal-index 6-cycles yield C(n,3) codim-five 3×3 rank-one cones, multiplicity 6. No induced ≥8-cycle is possible because each left vertex has only one forbidden right neighbor. Primitive lattice saturation makes these characteristic-free. All boundary/middle equalities meet on the all-equal order-polytope segment, giving common P1; direct Boolean order-ideal classification leaves one smooth torus-fixed vertex.
